resources.string: Frosted glass is on: Oriel blurs the desktop behind this window.
Frosted glass is off, so the window is opaque.

Turn Translucency off in Oriel Settings and the window turns opaque straight away, and frosted again when it's back on. On other desktops it's frosted where the compositor blurs behind windows over ext-background-effect-v1, and opaque elsewhere.
